app.name: GridVault
app.tagline: Sovereign clinical records and bedside access control for Nigerian hospitals

landing.heroBody: GridVault enforces role, ward and duty checks on every chart open, redacts high-stigma fields at the server boundary, and keeps a tamper-evident, externally witnessed audit log of every access.
controls: Deny-by-default access decisions on role, ward and active duty
Field-level redaction of sensitive clinical data with a stated reason
Emergency override that is instant, scoped to one patient, and impossible to hide
Append-only audit ledger with external witness anchoring
Real-time abuse detection that blocks insider misuse
Offline-first ward terminals with deterministic sync and a paper downtime protocol
landing.complianceNote: GridVault implements the technical controls listed in docs/COMPLIANCE.md under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. It holds no certification or accreditation; deployment duties such as DPIA, staff training and physical security belong to the facility.
